units.summary: i18n-tasks missing_keys (diff): every key of the base locale (en) exists in fr and pt and vice versa. Comparison is over per-locale trees merged from all config/locales files, is plural-aware, and ignores date.*, devise.* and views.*.
units.evidence: spec/i18n_spec.rb:5,15-17 (i18n.missing_keys must be empty; run by the rspec job .github/workflows/ci.yml:238-240); config/i18n-tasks.yml:4 base_locale en, :98-105 ignore_missing date.*/devise.*/views.*
units.alint: Missing: parity between per-locale key sets merged across many files (config/locales/**/*.en.yml and en.yml versus *.fr.yml and fr.yml), with plural-leaf collapse and prefix ignores. key_parity compares one reference file with peers, and forem places some keys in different files per locale (errors.messages.* is in devise.en.yml but in fr.yml; time.formats.devise.* is in devise_invitable.en.yml but in pt.yml). 114 per-file key_parity rules (57 en files times fr and pt) give 8 false positives at HEAD.
units.reason: R7: a tool check over YAML files alint reads, classified by what it asserts. Per-file key_parity cannot express parity of merged per-locale trees without false positives (shown at HEAD). Over (locale, key) rows, every key must occur in every locale: a per-key count of distinct locales, which is cardinality (Stage B).

changes.why: B-config is right: I reproduced Stage A's evidence with 114 per-file key_parity rules (57 en files × fr/pt, strip_root, plurals: cldr, ignore date/devise/views), which give exactly 8 false positives at HEAD from relocated keys. The family tag is the problem. v0.23 README items 4-5 say the slice ships locale key parity as a conformance policy using only equality, unique-key and cardinality. Merged-tree parity is a per-key count_distinct(locale) == |locales| over (locale, key) rows, i.e. cardinality. The many-file merge is a selector concern (path-captured locale over *.{locale}.yml and **/{locale}.yml), not an assertion family. Stage A's "needs set, not one of the three slice families" contradicts the v0.23 plan and wrongly keeps the flagship locale unit out of the after-slice figure. Phase 8 must confirm plural collapse and ignore prefixes.
Stage B's 114 rules (57 en files times fr and pt) are the probe, and Stage B retagged the unit cardinality; the alint and reason fields still said 57 rules and B-config/set.

changes.detail: Replaced the first-line root-key regex with the column-0 regex '(?m)^([A-Za-z]{2,3}(?:[-_][A-Za-z0-9]+)*):[ \t]*\r?$'. Narrowed source.files from config/locales/*.yml to the dot-free, locale-shaped glob 'config/locales/{[a-z][a-z],[a-z][a-z][a-z],[a-z][a-z]-[A-Z][A-Z],[a-z][a-z]_[A-Z][A-Z]}.yml'. source.files takes only one glob, so a '!*.*.yml' exclude cannot be used. This rule covers the constant-to-files direction. It passes on the clone and on the scratch base. On scratch it fires on a de.yml that starts with '# German' and then 'de:', on SUPPORTED_LOCALES with "pt" removed, and on SUPPORTED_LOCALES with "de" added and no de.yml. It does not fire on a devise.de.yml whose root is de:. Under the original config the leading-comment de.yml and the de.yml rooted en: both passed (fail-open), and devise.de.yml fired.

Covers the files-to-constant direction by dot-free stem, which is what the spec checks. It is a for_each_file with select ["config/locales/*.yml", "!config/locales/*.*.yml"] and a nested file_content_matches on app/lib/constants/settings/user_experience.rb with pattern '(?m)^[ \t]*"{stem}"[ \t]*=>'. I used this instead of Stage B's `relation: registered, register_as: {stem}`: registered takes one source glob, so it could not drop dotted stems for every stem shape. This form covers any dot-free stem. It passes on the clone and on the scratch base. On scratch it fires on a de.yml whose root key is en: (the case the set_equals rule misses), on the leading-comment de.yml, and on "pt" removed from the constant. It does not fire on a dotted-only devise.de.yml.

file_content_matches '\{%\s*feature\b[^%]*icon="[a-z0-9-]+"' on app/views/pages/_editor_liquid_help.en.html.erb, which is the spec's not_to be_empty half. It passes on the clone and on the scratch base. It fires on scratch when the only icon example (the icon="lightning" line) is deleted, while the existing subset rule passes vacuously. As a check, the existing forem-documented-feature-icons-in-icons rule fires on icon="not-an-icon". The unit stays C.

file_content_matches '(?s)SUPPORTED_LOCALES = \{[^}]*"pt"[ \t]*=>' on app/lib/constants/settings/user_experience.rb (A, locale). It passes on the clone and on the scratch base. On scratch I removed the "pt" key and deleted every *pt.yml file. This rule fired, and both forem-05 rules passed, which shows the two units are independent. It also fires when only "pt" is removed from the constant.

cross_file equals. Source is Gemfile.lock with '(?m)^    public_suffix \(([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)\)\r?$' (the single 4-space line at Gemfile.lock:747, 7.0.5). Target is the header line of gems/forem_native/crates/forem_core/src/psl_data.rs with '(?m)^//! Auto-generated ASCII rule table from `public_suffix` ([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+) ' (A, dep-version). registry_paths_resolve on lib/sidekiq/boot_memory_trimmer.rb, extract regex '(?m)^      ([A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_./-]*)$', base lint_root, expect dir (C). file_content_matches '(?s)ATTRIBUTES = %i\[[^\]]*\btype_of\b[^\]]*\]' on app/queries/homepage/articles_query.rb (A, other). It passes on the clone and on the scratch base. It fires on scratch when the `type_of` line is removed.
